note: Protocol facts for each blueprint: its head of state, its National Day and the five offices that receive the National Day letters. Kept by the Blueprints Steward, who checks every head of state once a month, and each nation again 15 days before its National Day, and updates this file and the band on the blueprint when the head of state changes. Portraits are supplied by the Steward-General (official portraits uploaded to the Media Library); until one is supplied the band shows the initials.
